versions.changelog:
- Clarified that no API key or environment variables are needed; shopping and order status work without authentication.
- Added stricter guidance: only send X-Moltbook-Identity for agent-specific endpoints (/agent/me, /agent/me/orders, /agent/me/preferences) and only if the agent runtime provides the token.
- Emphasized that identity tokens must never be inferred, generated, or sent unless explicitly provided by the agent environment.
- Improved compatibility and identity instructions to prevent accidental credential misuse.
- Enhanced documentation for agent-only endpoint usage and routine flows.

- Updated compatibility section to clarify that no API key is required for public endpoints, and explain optional Moltbook identity usage for /agent/me.
- Added note that supplying X-Moltbook-Identity to /agent/me exposes agent identity to forthecult.store.
- No functional or API changes; documentation clarification only.
No user-facing changes or file modifications were detected in this version.

## 1.0.1 Changelog

- Added security and safety guardrails: restrict API usage to documented endpoints, prevent following external or undocumented URLs, and clarify safe handling of suggestions.
- Introduced a required explicit user confirmation step before revealing crypto payment instructions.
- No file/code changes detected; documentation (SKILL.md) update only.

Initial release of the agentic-commerce-forthecult skill.

- Enables agents to autonomously browse, search, and purchase lifestyle, wellness, and tech products on forthecult.store.
- Supports multi-chain payments (Solana, Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Monero) and applies CULT token-holder discounts.
- Agents can view product details, create and track orders, and recommend suitable payment methods.
- No authentication required; guest checkout only, with privacy-focused design.
- Designed for seamless integration with modern agent frameworks (Molt, OpenClaw, Claude, ChatGPT, LangChain, AgentSkills).
